blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14 % of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9 M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. Only the RFA removes the rain while keeping the scene. The removal costs scene structure: CycleGAN-Turbo keeps more on every condition but fog. On VAE latents the identical adapter collapses to the identity, and decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output. The RFA has about 160 times fewer trainable parameters than CycleGAN-Turbo and under a fifth of its per-condition training time.
blocks.zh: 清除相片中的雾、雨或雪,或变成相片,必须去掉源域并保留现场。 未发音的翻译员通过它,因为他们的生成器看到源的外观(像素,一近不可逆的潜伏或控制图)并保存. DINO特征图修复了场景中的内容,并携带了天气,照明和渲染风格作为特征规范的13%至14%的残留. 我们提议采用代表特性适应器(RFA),即移动这种残留物的2.9M参数网络。 我们只训练适配器及其歧视者; 编码器和有特征条件的解码器, 训练一次所有条件, 保持冻结。 对CycleGAN-Turbo来说,在雾上和KID上都领先,在雪地、雨地和雾地上都处于噪音中。 它在两个度量衡上都领先REGEN和HyPER-GAN。 只有RFA在保留场景的同时去除雨量. 移除成本场景结构:CycleGAN-Turbo在除雾外的每一个条件上都保持较多. 在 VAE 上, 相同的适配器会崩溃到身份, 解码器来自其他组, RFA的可训练参数比CycleGAN-Turbo少了大约160倍,低于其每条件训练时间的五分之一.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Unpaired translators carry the source domain through, because their generator is shown the source appearance and keeps what it is shown. Clearing fog, rain or snow from a frame, turning a render into a photograph and night into day all require the source domain to disappear while the scene stays. Pixel-space GANs such as CycleGAN ( Zhu et al., 2017 ) and CUT ( Park et al., 2020 ) learn the translation from unpaired data but have to learn to generate as well. One-step diffusion finetuning such as CycleGAN-Turbo ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) adapts a pretrained generator until it produces the target domain, and controllable generators such as Cosmos-Transfer ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) train nothing and steer a pretrained video model with control maps. All three show their generator the input, as pixels, as a near-invertible latent of them or as a control map computed from them, and we call such methods pixel-fed. The usual escape is a geometric control such as depth or edges, which captures only a narrow aspect of the scene ( Dominici et al., 2026 ) and leaves the generator to invent the rest.
blocks.zh: 未发音的翻译员将源域带过,因为他们的生成器显示源外观并保留显示的内容. 从一帧中清除出雾,雨或雪,将一个渲染物变成相片并被夜到白昼,都要求源域在现场停留时消失. CycleGAN(Zhu等,2017年)和CUT(Park等,2020年)等像素-空间GANs从未发作的数据中学习翻译,但也必须学习生成. 单步扩散微调如CycleGAN-Turbo(Parmar等,2024年)会调整一个被预先训练的生成器直至生成目标域,而Cosmos-Transfer(NVIDIA,2025年)等可控制的生成器则不进行再培训并引导一个带有控制地图的被预先训练的视频模型. 所有三个都显示他们的生成器,作为像素,作为它们的近乎不可逆的潜伏,或者作为从它们计算出来的控制图,我们称之为以像素为原料的这种方法. 通常出逃是深度或边缘等几何控制,它只捕捉到场景的狭长一面(Dominici等,2026年)并让发电机来发明其余部分.

blocks.en: A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style only as a small residue. Dense self-supervised features carry the whole scene, its structure and semantics with the appearance entangled in them, and suffice to condition a frozen diffusion model ( Dominici et al., 2026 ) . We call the part of the feature map that an adapter must change to turn fog into clear weather, or a render into a photograph, the residue, and Section 3 measures it. We therefore train a feature-conditioned decoder once to reconstruct images from their feature maps, freeze it, and translate in front of it by moving the residue and leaving the rest of the map in place.
blocks.zh: DINO特征地图将现场内容固定下来,并仅作为少量残留物携带天气,照明和渲染风格. Dense自导自演的特征承载了整个场景,其结构与语义与外观缠绕于其中,并足以给被冻结的传播模型附加条件(Dominici等,2026. 我们称地物图中的一部分是适配器必须改变才能将雾化为晴朗的天气,或者将成像物化为相片,残余物,第3节对此进行测量. 因此,我们训练了一台具有地物条件的解码器,从他们的地物地图上重建出图像,将其冻结,并在前方通过移动残余物来翻译,将地图的其余部分留在原地.

blocks.en: We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA) , a small feed-forward residual network that maps one DINO feature map to another (Section 4.2 ). It is trained CycleGAN-style, with the adversarial gradient passing back through the frozen decoder, and everything else it relies on is frozen: the encoder, the decoder and the vision model inside its discriminator ( Kumari et al., 2022 ) . Because the adapter learns only the residue, it fits in a small network and trains in a few thousand steps. On VAE latents the identical adapter does not translate (Section 3 ), which shows that the feature space matters. To our knowledge, the RFA is the first learned mapping between domains inside a frozen self-supervised feature space.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用代表特性适应器(RFA),这是一个小型的向导残余网络,将一个DINO特征图映射到另一个(第4.2节)。 它被训练出CycleGAN风格,对抗梯度会从被冻结的解码器上回转,它所依赖的一切都会被冻结:解码器,解码器以及其歧视者内部的视觉模型(Kumari等,2022年). 由于适配器只学习残留物,它适合入小网络并训练了几千步. 在 VAE 潜入时, 相同的适配器不会翻译( 第 3 节), 这表明特性空间很重要 。 据我们所知,RFA是第一个在被冰冻的自我监督的地物空间内,在域间学习到的绘图.

blocks.en: We make four contributions, and the first is a measured diagnosis of why pixel-fed translators fail: their generator can still recover the source domain from what it is shown. The identical adapter translates on DINO features and collapses to the identity on VAE latents, and the domain it moves is 13 to 14 % of the feature norm (Section 3 ). Second, the RFA is a 2.9 M-parameter adapter on a frozen encoder and decoder. It is ahead of a finetuned CycleGAN-Turbo on both distribution metrics (KID and FID) on fog and on KID on night, and level with it within noise on snow, rain and haze (Appendix H ). On rain it removes the weather where the pixel-fed baselines that keep the scene carry the wet sheen through (Section 6.1 , Figure 2 , Appendix F ). Third, we measure the trade that removal costs, since the lossiness that lets the adapter remove the weather also moves scene structure, and we report both ends (Section 6.3 ). Fourth, because the adapter maps a feature map to a feature map, decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output (Section 6.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们做出了4个贡献,第1个是对像素素的翻译器为何失败的量度诊断:他们的生成器仍然可以从显示的内容中恢复出源域. 相同的适配器在DINO特性上翻译并倒塌到VAE潜想上的身份上,它移动的域为特性规范的13%至14%(第3节. 第二,RFA是冷冻编码器和解码器上2.9M参数适配器. 它领先于对雾上和夜晚KID的分布度量(KID和FID)进行微调的CycleGAN-Turbo,并在雪地、雨地和雾地的噪音中达到平分(附录H)。 在下雨时,它消除了维持场景的以像素为生的基线带湿雪茄穿过的天气(第6.1节,图2,附录F)。 第三,我们衡量去除成本的交易,因为让适配器去除天气的失常也会移动场景结构,我们报告两端(第6.3节)。 第四,因为适配器将一个特征地图映射到一个特征地图,所以解码器来自其他从未看到其输出的组(第6.5节).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: What the generator is given. Every unpaired translator family shows its generator the source appearance. Pixel-space GANs (CycleGAN ( Zhu et al., 2017 ) , CUT ( Park et al., 2020 ) and the ViT-generator line ( Torbunov et al., 2023 ) ) see the input image. CycleGAN-Turbo ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) finetunes the pretrained one-step generator SD-Turbo ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) on the VAE-encoded input, and Cosmos-Transfer ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) sees control maps computed from the input. UNIT-DDPM ( Sasaki et al., 2021 ) , CycleGAN’s diffusion counterpart without a cycle term, translates by many-step sampling conditioned on the source image. Our decoder sees a semantic feature map, and Section 6.1 measures what that changes.
blocks.zh: 发电机是给的 每个未受宠若惊的翻译家都显示其生成器的源外观. Pixel-space GANs (CycleGAN (Zhu等,2017年), CUT). (Park等,2020年)和Vit-generator线(Torbunov等,2023年)参见输入图像. CycleGAN-Turbo(Parmar等,2024年)在VAE编码输入上微调了预先训练的一阶发电机SD-Turbo(Sauer等,2024年),Cosmos-Transfer(NVIDIA,2025年)看到从输入中计算出的控制图. IT-DDPM(Sasaki等人,2021年),周期 GAN的传播对应物没有循环术语,由以源图像为条件的多步采样来翻译. 我们的解码器看到一个语义特征图, 第6.1节测量它的变化。

blocks.en: Translating in feature space. Earlier feature-space translators differ in whose features they adapt, whether they render, or what they train. CyCADA ( Hoffman et al., 2018 ) adapted a task network’s own activations with a jointly trained decoder and found feature-level adaptation stronger on harder shifts; we freeze encoder and decoder. DosGAN ( Lin et al., 2019 ) learns to split its own encoder’s code into domain-specific and domain-independent parts; we measure this split in a frozen self-supervised feature space (Section 3 ). DA-F2F ( Oh et al., 2026 ) modulates a detector’s features and never renders. Our nearest neighbour, the Self-Supervised Semantic Bridge ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , passes through a frozen, appearance-invariant DINO feature space only as a meeting point for generators trained per domain. It learns nothing inside that feature space, so a new pair needs a new generator, while we learn the map there and train no generator. PRISM ( Yoshai and Shaked, 2026 ) adapts inside a frozen text-to-image generator, whereas we adapt in front of one. Cyclone ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) , the closest contemporaneous work on our task, finetunes a Stable Diffusion UNet on the source frame’s VAE latent, so its generator is pixel-fed.
blocks.zh: 以特色空间翻译. 早期的地物-空间翻译在他们适应的特性,无论是制作还是训练方面,都有所不同. CyCADA(Hoffman等,2018年)用联合训练的解码器改造了一个任务网络自身的活化器,并在更硬的转向上发现地物级适应更强;我们冻结了编码器和解码器. DosGAN(Lin等,2019年)学习将自己的编码器代码分拆成域名和域名独立的部分;我们用被冻结的自控特性空间(第3节)来测量这种分解. DA-F2F(Oh等人,2026年)调制出一个探测器的特性,从不制造. 我们最近的邻居,即自我监督的语义桥(Liu等,2026年),经过一个冰冻而外观变化无常的DINO特性空间,只是作为每个域训练发电机的会场. 它在那个空间里什么也学不到,所以一对新人需要一个新的发电机, 而我们在那里学习地图,并训练没有发电机。 PISM(Yoshai and Shaked, 2026)在一个被冻结的文本到图像生成器内部进行适应,而我们则在一个前进行适应. 气旋(Nguyen等, 2026年), 是目前我们任务中最接近的工作,

blocks.en: Self-supervised features as a generative space. DINOv2 and DINOv3 features ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) are an established stand-in for a VAE latent. Representation Autoencoders ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) and VFM-VAE ( Bi et al., 2026 ) train a decoder for them. Representation alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ) speeds up diffusion training in this feature space, SVG ( Shi et al., 2026 ) runs the diffusion itself there, and PiD ( Lu et al., 2026 ) decodes it with pixel diffusion. DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) and MIRA ( Hu et al., 2026 ) build world models on it because it stays recoverable under prediction error, unlike a reconstruction codec’s latent ( Nilaksh et al., 2026 ) . None of them tests whether this feature space is a good place for domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的特征作为一个基因空间. DINOv2和DINOv3特征(Oquab等,2024;Siméoni等,2025)是VAE潜伏物的固定站点. 代表自动编码器(郑等,2026;辛格等,2026)和VFM-VAE(Bi等,2026)为他们进行解码器培训. 代表对接(Yu等,2025年)加快了这个地物空间的传播训练,SVG(Shi等,2026年)在那里运行传播本身,而PiD(Lu等,2026年)用像素传播来解码. DINO-WM(周克等,2025年)和MIRA(胡克等,2026年)在它上建起世界模型,因为它在预测错误下仍然可以恢复,与重建编码器的潜伏不同(Nilaksh等,2026年). 没有一个测试这个特征空间是否是适合域适应的好地方.

blocks.en: Conditioning on features, and adapting them. Our decoder, the case for swapping it, and our adversarial signal come from work on frozen features. Control-DINO ( Dominici et al., 2026 ) conditions a video diffusion ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) on dense DINOv3 features and is our decoder’s ancestor. Driving with DINO ( Chen et al., 2026 ) does this on a frozen Cosmos model and reports the trade of realism against scene structure we also measure. Splicing ViT Features ( Tumanyan et al., 2022 ) edits a frozen DINO feature space per image, without a generative model. Latent-space anchoring ( Huang et al., 2023 ) and FAE ( Gao et al., 2025 ) argue for swappable decoders. FAE treats the tension that representation encoders favour high-dimensional features and generators low-dimensional latents as a mismatch to close, whereas we exploit it. Our zero-initialised head is ControlNet’s zero-initialised residual ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Khazem, 2026 ) . The adversarial signal follows vision-aided GAN training ( Kumari et al., 2022 ) with a frozen DINOv2 inside the discriminator, so encoder, adapter and discriminator share one feature space.
blocks.zh: 以地物为条件,并对其进行改造。 我们的解码器 交换它的理由 以及我们的对抗信号 来自于关于被冻结的特性的工作 控制-DINO (Dominici等人,2026年)在密集的DINov3特性上为视频传播控制网(Zhang等人,2023年)设定了条件,并是我们解码器的祖先. 与DINO(Chen等,2026年)一起驾驶, Splicing ViT Features(Tumanyan等,2022年)编辑了被冷冻的DINO特征空间每幅图像,没有基因模型. Latent-space socking (Huang等, 2023)和FAE (Gao等, 2025)主张可互换解码器. FAE将代表编码器偏好高维特性和生成出低维潜质的张力视为不匹配而关闭,而我们则加以利用. 我们的零初始化头目是ControlNet的零初始化后遗症(张等,2023;Khazem,2026). 对抗信号遵循视觉辅助GAN训练(Kumari等,2022年),歧视者体内有被冻结的DINOv2,因此编码器,适配器和歧视者共享一个特征空间.

blocks.en: The two applications. Prior work on both applications differs from ours in failure mode or protocol. Sim-to-real photorealism runs from EPE ( Richter et al., 2022 ) to its real-time distillations REGEN ( Pasios and Nikolaidis, 2026b ) and HyPER-GAN ( Pasios and Nikolaidis, 2026a ) , the baselines of Table 3 , which keep scene structure exactly and transfer appearance only, the opposite failure mode to ours. Adverse-weather restoration ( Pan et al., 2026 ; Guan et al., 2025 ) evaluates on paired synthetic degradations with PSNR and SSIM. Our ACDC ( Sakaridis et al., 2021 ) and haze settings are unpaired real data scored with KID ( Bińkowski et al., 2018 ) and structure distance, so the protocols are not interchangeable. Structure distance ( Tumanyan et al., 2022 ) compares an output with its own input: it is the mean squared difference of their DINO key self-similarity maps, and it is the DINO column of our tables.
blocks.zh: 两种应用. 之前在两种应用上的工作在故障模式或协议上都不同于我们的. Sim-to-Realphotalism从EPE(Richter等,2022年)到其实时分馏REGEN(Pasios and Nikolaidis,2026b.)和HyPER-GAN(Pasios and Nikolaidis,2026a.),表3的基线保持了场景结构的准确性并只将外观转移,相反的失败模式与我们的. 逆天气还原(Pan等,2026;Guan等,2025)与PSNR和SSIM对等合成降解进行评估。 我们的ACDC(Sakaridis等,2021年)和雾霾设置都是与KID(Bindkowski等,2018年)和结构相距不相上下的真实数据,因此协议无法互换. 结构相距(Tumanyan等,2022年)将一出输出与自己的输入相比较:这是它们DINO密钥自相仿图的正平方差,也是我们表格中的DINO一栏.

blocks.en: 3 Why features and not latents
blocks.zh: 3个 为什么是特征而不是潜伏

blocks.en: Table 1: The identical adapter and recipe on three conditionings. Raw change is how much the adapter changes its input; translation is that change with a per-channel affine colour map factored out, so a global re-grade does not count; colour share is the part of the raw change that the affine map explains. A negative share means the change is not a global colour shift at all.
blocks.zh: 表1:三个条件的相同适配器和配方。 原始变化是适配器改变其输入的多少;翻译是用每个通道的affine色彩映射系数来进行改变,所以一个全局再级不计;颜色共享是affine映射解释的原始变化的一部分. 负份额意味着变化根本不是全局色彩的转变.

blocks.en: On a VAE latent the RFA collapses to the identity or re-grades the image, although the latent reconstructs better (Table 1 ). We trained the identical adapter on two latents, the DC-AE of our decoder’s backbone (Sana-Sprint, Section 4.1 ) and FLUX’s VAE, which reconstruct at a third to a half of DINOv2’s error. At the loss weights of Section 4.3 both stay at the identity, and when pushed out of collapse by a higher adversarial weight they re-grade the image, with a global tone shift accounting for over 40 % of what they change. With that shift factored out, the adapter on DINOv2 does 1.7 to 2.4 times the translation of either latent. The two latents thus reconstruct better, re-grade and translate less, while DINOv2 reconstructs worst, shows no colour share and translates most.
blocks.zh: 在VAE的潜伏下,RFA会倒塌到身份上或者对图像进行再分级,尽管潜伏的再造效果更好(表1)。 我们训练同样的适配器使用两种潜想,即我们解码器主干线的DC-AE(Sana-Sprint,第4.1节)和FLU-s VAE,它们重建了DINov2错误的三分之一至一半。 在4.3节的减重中,两者都保持身份,当被更高的对抗性重量推出倒塌时,它们会重新对图像进行分级,全球调值变化占变化的40%以上。 随着这一转变的出现,DINOv2上的适配器的翻译量是其中任何一种潜伏的1.7至2.4倍。 两种潜质因此重建得更好,再分级和翻译得更少,而DINOv2重建得最差,没有显示颜色份额并翻译得最多.

blocks.en: One mechanism predicts this split: the adapter’s leverage is whatever the conditioning leaves undetermined. DINO features are lossy and semantic, and they were never trained to be decoded. Many images share one feature map, so the map fixes what is in the scene and leaves how it looks to the backbone’s appearance prior. A VAE latent is near-invertible and leaves the backbone nothing to decide. Every change of appearance must then be written by the adapter inside the manifold of valid latents, where the cheapest direction is a global re-grade.
blocks.zh: 一种机制预测这种分化:适配器的杠杆是任何条件未定的. DINO特征是失落和语义化的,他们从未受过解码训练. 许多图像共享一个特征地图,因此地图会修正场景中的内容,并留下它如何看待骨干之前的外观. 一种VAE潜伏是近乎不可逆的,使骨干没有什么可决定的. 然后,每次外观变化都必须由适配器在有效潜伏的多面内写出,其中最便宜的方向是全球再分级.

blocks.en: The residue, what the adapter changes on a DINO feature map, is 13 to 14 % of the feature norm in every condition, fog, snow, rain, haze and night alike. We measure it everywhere in the paper as the adapter’s relative move on a test frame’s feature map, ‖ G ⁡ ( f ) − f ‖ / ‖ f ‖ \|G(f)-f\|/\|f\| , averaged over each condition’s test crops. Here G G is the source-to-target adapter and f f the DINOv2-B/reg map in the decoder’s per-channel normalisation (Appendix D.2 ). On an already clear input the trained adapters of Section 6 move the map by 3 to 6 % (Table 7 ), and any other photograph, of any weather, sits about a full norm away. We also report a DINOv3-S configuration for replication, which reads DINOv3-S features through a 0.6 B ControlNet (Section 4.1 ). There every distance is about half as large, and this measure reads 5 to 9 %. In both feature spaces the move is 10 to 16 % of the distance between two frames of one weather (Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Training is one-sided by default. Top row: the frozen encoder maps the frame to a feature map, G G adapts it, the frozen decoder renders it, and the target discriminators judge the render against real frames, their gradient reaching G G through the decoder. Bottom row: F F maps target features back and learns only from the cycle and identity terms. Dashed: the symmetric variant (Section 4.3 ). At inference only the top row runs, with the decoder at two steps.

blocks.en: We train only the two RFA adapters ( G G and F F , one per direction) and the discriminators, and keep the encoder, the ControlNet and the Sana-Sprint backbone frozen throughout. The decoder, meaning the ControlNet and the backbone it drives, only maps feature maps to pixels, so every domain pair shares one decoder and a new pair needs only a new adapter. CycleGAN-Turbo instead builds one generator per domain pair, with the translation baked into LoRA weights inside the UNet.
blocks.zh: 我们只培训两个RFA适配器(G和F F,每个方向一个)以及歧视者,并保持编码器,ControlNet和Sana-Sprint主干线全被冻结. 解码器,指ControlNet及其所驱动的主干线,只将特征地图映射到像素上,因此每个域对共享一个解码器,而一对新配对只需要一个新的适配器. CycleGAN-Turbo转而每组域对构建一个生成器,翻译后被烤入UNet内部的LORA重量.

blocks.en: The decoder has to be in the loop, and differentiable in one pass. With a feature-space discriminator alone, the adapter either stays at the identity or shifts the feature statistics in directions the frozen decoder discards, so the rendered image barely changes. The residue becomes identifiable only when the discriminator judges the rendered image and the gradient returns through the frozen decoder (Appendix C.1 ). We therefore compute the adversarial and pixel-space terms on the decoded image and back-propagate them through the frozen decoder to the adapter. This needs a decoder that maps features to pixels in one differentiable pass, because unrolling several sampling steps would hamper gradient propagation and multiply the memory and cost of every step. Ours is a DINO ControlNet on Sana-Sprint 1.6 B ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , a distilled few-step backbone, trained once against the backbone’s teacher and run on the student at 1024 × \times 1024 (Appendix D.2 ). The decoder runs one step during adapter training and two at inference, its shipped default (Appendix D.1 ). Any single differentiable pass from a feature map to pixels qualifies, and Appendix D.4 trains the adapter through three such decoders, among them RAE’s ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 解码器必须在循环中,在一次传入中可以不同. 仅凭特征-空间区分器,适配器要么停留在身份上,要么将特征统计向被冻结的解码器丢弃物的方向转移,因此所渲染的图像几乎没有变化. 只有当歧视者判断成像和梯度通过被冻结的解码器返回(附录C.1.)时,残留物才变得可以识别。 因此我们计算解码图像上的对抗和像素-空格术语,然后通过被冻结的解码器向适配器后放出. 这需要一个解码器,将特性映射到一个不同的相像素上,因为不滚动几个采样步骤会妨碍梯度传播,并增加每个步骤的内存和成本。 Ours是Sana-Sprint 1.6 B上的DINO控制网(Chen等,2025年), 解码器在适配器训练期间运行了一步并有两步推论,其被运出默认值(附录 D.1 . 任何从地物映射到像素的单一不同通道都符合条件,附录D.4通过三个这样的解码器对适配器进行训练,其中包括RAE ' s(郑等,2026;辛格等,2026).

blocks.en: Every reported RFA result uses DINOv2-B/reg feature maps of size 768 × 32 × 32 768\times 32\times 32 , from a 448-px input, in the per-channel normalisation PiD consumes (Appendix D.2 ). The 1.6 B ControlNet was trained on this map, and PiD and RAE read it too (Section 6.5 ). blocks.en: 4.2 The RFA
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 卢旺达部队

blocks.en: The RFA reads a feature map with C channels and writes a map of equal shape. A 1 × \times 1 stem compresses C → \rightarrow 256 and four depthwise-separable dilated residual blocks follow (dilations 1, 2, 4, 1; GroupNorm-8; SiLU; MLP ratio 2). A zero-initialised 1 × \times 1 head returns 256 → \rightarrow C through a global residual and makes forward(x) == x at initialisation. Training thus starts from passing features through unchanged, so the frozen decoder is in distribution from step 0 and the adversarial loss never judges a meaningless render. The adapter is a feed-forward map and nothing more. It does no sampling or iteration and never sees the decoder, so anything that consumes a feature map can consume the adapted one (Section 6.5 ). It uses convolutions, because full self-attention over a dense feature map is quadratic in the number of positions and is not needed to move the residue.

blocks.en: 4.3 Objective and discriminators
blocks.zh: 4.3 目标和歧视者

blocks.en: The objective computes CycleGAN’s cycle and identity terms on feature maps instead of pixels. G G maps source to target and F F maps target to source, and each should invert the other’s output and leave its own domain unchanged. The adversarial part is one-sided by default (Figure 1 ). Only G G ’s output is rendered through the frozen decoder and judged against real frames by the target domain’s two discriminators. G G thus receives a gradient from an image, while F F , the cycle’s return path, learns from the feature-space terms alone. The symmetric variant, which also renders and judges F F ’s output, reached similar distribution scores with less structure drift in one matched sim-to-real comparison, at 1.5 times the time per step and more memory. Every reported result is one-sided.
blocks.zh: 目标计算出CycleGAN在地物图上而不是像素上的循环和身份术语. GG映射出目标源和F映射出目标源,每个都应当倒置对方的输出并保持自有域不变. 对抗部分默认为单方(图1). 只有G的输出是通过被冻结的解码器提供的,并且由目标域的两个歧视者根据真实框架进行判断. GG因此从一个图像得到一个梯度,而周期的回路FFF则仅从特征-空间术语中学习. 对称性变体也使F F 的产量得到评分,在一次匹配的正比实比中,以每步1.5倍的时间和更多的内存达到相似的分配分数,结构漂移较少. 每个报告的结果都是片面的。

blocks.en: Two discriminators judge the decoded image. The main signal comes from a vision-aided discriminator ( Kumari et al., 2022 ) , a frozen DINOv2-with-registers model with a small trained head. With the encoder and decoder frozen as well, the game has one trainable network on each side. A small PatchGAN judges local patches of the render and keeps a useful gradient on materials and road surface after the vision-aided term has settled. Table 4 lists the loss weights (Appendix A.1 ).

blocks.en: 5 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: ACDC ( Sakaridis et al., 2021 ) supplies fog, snow and rain as real frames, which we use unpaired for training. Its clear frame of each place, shot in another season, is the paired reference, used for instance in the MAE column and the last column of Figure 2 . River-camera haze (HIVIS) consists of USGS frames in the selection of Henein et al. (2026) . BDD100K ( Yu et al., 2020 ) supplies night to day, and PreSIL ( Hurl et al., 2019 ) with Mapillary Vistas ( Neuhold et al., 2017 ) the sim-to-real pair (Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh: ACDC (Sakaridis等, 2021年) 提供雾,雪和雨作为活框,我们用它们来进行训练. 它在另一季拍摄的每个地方的清晰框架是成对参考,例如,在MAE一栏和图2的最后一栏中使用。 河-相机雾霾 (HIVIS)由USGS框架组成,选择了Henein等人(2026年). BDD100K (Yu等,2020年) 提供夜间至白天,而PreSIL (Hurl等,2019年)与Mapillery Vistas (Neuhold等,2017年) 成真对 (Appendix B.1 ).

blocks.en: KID ( Bińkowski et al., 2018 ) is the primary distribution metric, because FID is rank-deficient with 50 generated images against 2048-dimensional features. Both come from clean-fid (KID as the mean over its subsets), and re-scoring unchanged crops moves KID by about 0.001 on 50 crops and about 0.002 on the 25 haze crops. Sampling error over the crops is larger, and Appendix H gives jackknife standard errors. Every method is scored on one shared centre-square crop and reported at the end of its own published recipe, and every retrained baseline runs its repository’s full recipe.
blocks.zh: KID 软件 (Binkowski等,2018年)是主要分布度量衡,因为FID在2048维特性上有50个生成的图像被排出排行榜. 两者都来自清洁纤维(KID作为它的子集的平均值),重新评分不变的作物使KID在50个作物上移动了约0.001个,在25个雾霾作物上移动了约0.002个. 作物抽样误差较大,附录H给出了千刀标准误差. 每一种方法都用一个共享的中央平方作物得分,并在自己公布的食谱结尾处报告,每一次重新训练的基线都使用其储存库的全部食谱。

blocks.en: 6.1 Adverse-weather restoration
blocks.zh: 6.1 逆天气恢复

blocks.en: On fog the RFA is ahead of CycleGAN-Turbo on KID and FID by more than two standard errors, and on night it is ahead on KID (Table 2 , Appendix H ). On snow, rain and haze the two are level: the KID differences are within one standard error, and the RFA’s lower FID on rain and haze is one to one and a half. CUT’s fog KID, 0.0255 against the RFA’s 0.0262, is the one distribution-metric cell where a pixel-space GAN leads. CycleGAN-Turbo’s end-of-recipe fog model sits on a spike of an oscillating curve, and like every baseline it is reported at the end of its recipe (Section 5 ). Cosmos-Transfer shows both failure modes of Section 1 at once, since its blur control carries the weather through and its edge control clears it by inventing the scene (Appendix C.2 ). CycleGAN-Sprint, our rebuild of CycleGAN-Turbo on the Sana-Sprint backbone, is discussed in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: 在雾上,RFA在KID和FID上的CycleGAN-Turbo上领先两个以上的标准出错,而晚上在KID上领先(表2,附录H.). 在雪地上,雨地和雾地是两级:KID差异在一个标准误差范围内,RFA在雨地和雾地上的低摄入量是一到一到一到一到一到一分. CUT的雾KID,0.0255与RFA的0.0262对齐,是像素-空间GAN领先的一个分布度量电池. CycleGAN-Turbo的收尾雾模型坐落在一股斜曲线上,与每一个基线一样,它都在其配方的末端(第5节)被报道. Cosmos-Transfer同时显示第1节的两种故障模式,因为其模糊的控制带过天气,其边缘控制通过发明场景(Appendix C.2. CycleGAN-Sprint,我们重建 CycleGAN-Turbo 在Sana-Sprint主干线,在第7节讨论.

blocks.en:
The distribution metrics do not say whether the weather is gone, and ACDC’s references, shot in another season, cannot say it either. In the fog row of Figure 2 the foggy frames have bare trees and the clear ones full summer foliage, so matching the clear distribution means growing leaves, and the RFA and CycleGAN-Turbo both do. MAE against these references therefore cannot rank how well a method keeps scene structure (Section 6.3 ). We measure removal with a logistic classifier on pooled DINOv2-B/reg features, trained on 400 adverse and 400 clear ACDC training crops per condition and never on a test or rendered frame. It reaches held-out accuracy 1.00, and trained to split one class into random halves it stays at or below chance (0.30 to 0.46).
On rain it calls every RFA output clear, against 0.36 to 0.54 for CycleGAN-Turbo, CycleGAN-Sprint, CycleGAN and CUT and none for Cosmos-Transfer’s blur control. The only other method that clears rain, Cosmos-Transfer’s edge control, does so by redrawing the scene. On fog the classifier calls fewer RFA outputs clear (0.68) than CycleGAN or CUT (1.00) or CycleGAN-Turbo (0.84). This is confounded, because its clear training crops are summer frames and a method that matches them grows leaves (Appendix F ). Snow does not discriminate, since nearly every method is called clear there, and haze and night have no training crops and are not scored.

blocks.en: 6.3 What the removal costs
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 搬运费

blocks.en: The lossiness that lets the adapter remove the weather also moves scene structure. What each method keeps and loses follows from what its generator is given (Figure 2 , Appendix C.3 ). CycleGAN-Turbo’s generator sees a near-invertible latent of the input, so it keeps the scene and carries part of the weather through. It keeps structure better on snow, rain and haze, by 1.5 to 2.5 times on structure distance, and slightly on night (0.029 against 0.036), while on fog the RFA keeps more (0.021 against 0.064). CycleGAN-Turbo is also the only method that keeps burned-in overlay text legible, which matters for the HIVIS application.
blocks.zh: 让适配器去除天气的失落也移动了场景结构. 每种方法的保存和损失都源于其生成器的获得(图2,附录C.3)。 CycleGAN-Turbo的生成器看到输入的近乎不可逆的潜伏,因此它保持了场景并携带了部分天气穿过. 它在雪地,雨地和雾地上保持了较好的结构,在结构距离上维持了1.5到2.5倍,在夜间则略为保持了(0.029对0.036),而在雾地上,RFA保持了更多的(0.021对0.064). CycleGAN-Turbo也是保持被焚毁的上覆文本可辨识性的唯一方法,这对HIVIS应用很重要.

blocks.en: Structure distance compares each output with its own input frame, so it sees no seasonal change, and it measures how much a method changed, including wanted change. The real clear photograph of the scene, scored against the adverse input, reaches 0.08 on snow and rain, about three times the RFA’s value. A low value is therefore not the target, and the column is read with KID. A fixed COCO detector, which does not read DINO features, measures the same cost on a task (Appendix G ). Its mAP on RFA outputs is about half of that on the untouched BDD100K snow and rain frames. On sim-to-real the RFA keeps about a sixth of the objects in the untranslated render, against two thirds to three quarters for REGEN and HyPER-GAN.
blocks.zh: 结构相距将每个输出与自己的输入框进行比较,因此它没有看到季节性的变化,它测量一个方法的变化程度,包括想要的变化. 现场真实清晰相片与负面输入相抵得分,在雪地和雨地上达到0.08分,约为RFA值的三倍. 因此,低值不是目标,列会用 KID 读取. 一种不读取DINO特性的固定COCO探测器对一项任务进行相同的成本测量(附录G.). 它关于区域渔业局产出的mAP大约是未受影响的BDD100K雪和雨框的一半。 在正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正

blocks.en: 6.4 Cost
blocks.zh: 6.4 费用

blocks.en: The adapter trains about 160 times fewer weights than CycleGAN-Turbo, in under a fifth of the per-condition training time. On one server-grade GPU it trains 2.9 M weights, against 470 M for CycleGAN-Turbo and 148 M for CycleGAN-Sprint. It converges in about 1 800 of its 5 000 steps, where both CycleGAN variants run 25 000, so at a nearly equal cost per step (1.79 s against 1.86 s) one condition takes 2.4 h against 13.6 h for CycleGAN-Turbo. The decoder adds a one-time 8 to 19 h, shared by every condition and both directions, and over four conditions the total is 17.6 to 28.6 h against 54.4 h (Table 6 , Appendix 4 ).
blocks.zh: 适配器的列车重量比CycleGAN-Turbo少了大约160倍,低于每况下训练时间的五分之一. 在一个服务器级的GPU上,它训练了2.9M重量,CycleGAN-Turbo则为470M,CycleGAN-Sprint则为148M。 其5 000个步中约1 800个步相会合,两个CycleGAN的变体都运行有25 000个步相会合,因此每步费用几乎相等(1.79相比1.86相比),一个条件对CycleGAN-Turbo来说需要2.4 h相比13.6 h相比. 解码器增加了一次8至19小时,每个条件和双向共用,超过四个条件的总和为17.6至28.6小时,而54.4小时(表6,附录4)。

blocks.en: 6.5 Portability to PiD and RAE
blocks.zh: 6.5 可移植到PiD和RAE

blocks.en: If the adapter’s output is a valid feature map, decoders trained only on features of real images should render it. Our conditioning reproduces the RAE encoding that PiD is built on (Section 4.1 ), so RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and PiD ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , two decoders from other groups, can test this.
blocks.zh: 如果适配器的输出是有效的特征映射,则只经过真实图像特征培训的解码器应该能够渲染出. 我们的构型复制了RAE编码,即PiD是建立在(第4.1节)上,因此RAE(郑等,2026年)和PiD(吕等,2026年)这两个来自其他群体的解码器可以测试这个.

PiD (pixel diffusion, four steps) and RAE (one deterministic pass), two decoders of DINOv2 feature maps from other groups, decode the unadapted PreSIL features (“raw”) and the same features after the sim-to-real RFA. Neither decoder saw the RFA, and the RFA saw neither. Three more frames in Figure 7 .

blocks.en: Both decoders render the adapted maps (Figure 4 ). From the unadapted features they render the game frame back, and from the adapted features they keep the scene structure and change its appearance. The lane markings, the billboard, the tower and the car’s position carry through in every column. The decoders differ only where the features are silent, such as the colour of a car on some frames (Section 6.2 ), which the decoder samples and the adapter does not set (Appendix C.6 ). Two decoders that were never in the loop read these maps alike, the strongest evidence available that the adapted map is a valid point in the feature space and not an artefact tuned to one decoder.
blocks.zh: 两个解码器都渲染出被修改过的地图(图4. 从未适应的特性,他们使游戏框回放,从被适应的特性,他们保持了场景结构并改变其外观. 车道标志,告示牌,塔和汽车的位置在每个栏目中贯穿. 解码器仅在特性无声的情况下才有所不同,例如一些帧上一辆车的颜色(第6.2节),解码器样本和适配器没有设置(附录C.6.). 两个从未在环上读过这些地图的解码器, 现有的最有力的证据表明,经过调整的地图是特征空间中一个有效的点, 而不是一个调取到一个解码器的动画。

blocks.en: 7 The same-backbone comparison
blocks.zh: 第7条 同一后骨比较

blocks.en: With the backbone held fixed, the RFA has the lower KID on fog, snow, rain and night and loses it on haze. Table 2 is a task-level comparison, and CycleGAN-Sprint, which rebuilds CycleGAN-Turbo on our Sana-Sprint backbone, is the nearest controlled one. It keeps every setting CycleGAN-Turbo’s paper or code fixes, except the residual LoRA and adversarial weight the backbone forces (Appendix D.3 ). The port runs in this direction because our decoder recipe needs the backbone’s teacher, which SD-Turbo does not publish. On fog, snow, rain and night the RFA’s KID is 0.026, 0.021, 0.016 and 0.014 against 0.034, 0.032, 0.019 and 0.021. On haze CycleGAN-Sprint’s 0.029 against the RFA’s 0.038 is the best KID of any method, at a structure cost (0.058 against 0.043). CycleGAN-Sprint keeps more structure on fog, rain and night by 0.002 to 0.009 and is level on snow. Its fog KID of 0.034 sits between the RFA’s 0.026 and CycleGAN-Turbo’s 0.048, our training with its released recipe.
blocks.zh: 随着骨干被固定,RFA在雾,雪,雨和夜上拥有更低的KID并被雾弄丢了. 表2是任务级别比较,CycleGAN-Sprint在我们Sana-Sprint主干线上重建CycleGAN-Turbo的CycleGAN-Sprint是最近的被控制. 它保留了每一个设置 CycleGAN-Turbo 的纸张或代码修饰,除了残余的LORA和对抗性重量的主干力量(附录D.3. 我们的解码器配方需要骨干老师, 在雾、雪、雨和夜间,RFA的KID为0.026、0.021、0.016和0.014,对应于0.034、0.032、0.019和0.021。 在烟雾循环GAN-Sprint的0.029对RFA的0.038是任何方法中最好的KID,其结构成本(0.058对0.043). CycleGAN-Sprint在雾上,雨上和夜间保存了更多的结构以0.002至0.009为单位,并处于雪上平面. 它的0.034KID位于RFA的0.026和CycleGAN-Turbo的0.048之间,我们用它释放的食谱进行训练.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Realism and scene structure trade against each other. DINO conditioning changes materials convincingly but lets scene structure drift, and latent conditioning keeps structure but only re-grades. The trade follows from the adapter’s leverage (Section 3 ) and appeared with every decoder we trained; the RGB structure loss in the recipe (Table 4 ) moves the adapter along it without escaping it. We have not tried structure-consistency constraints or more adapter capacity.
blocks.zh: 现实主义和场景结构互相交易. DINO调制可以令人信服地改变材料,但让场景结构漂移,而潜伏的调制保持了结构,但只有再分级. 交易来源于适配器的杠杆(第3节), 与我们所训练的每一个解码器一起出现; 食谱中的RGB结构损失(表4)将适配器沿着它移动而未逃脱. 我们没有尝试结构一致性限制或更多的适应能力。

blocks.en: No temporal modelling. The method is per-frame, and we have not measured temporal consistency. The adapter is deterministic, so it adds no frame-to-frame variation of its own; flicker would come from sampling the image backbone independently per frame. In preliminary runs we placed the adapter in front of a video diffusion decoder conditioned on the same DINOv2 features, built as in Control-DINO ( Dominici et al., 2026 ) . We saw no visible flicker, which we attribute to the video model’s temporal prior, although some scene content changes over time. These runs are not part of the evaluation here.
blocks.zh: 没有时间建模。 这种方法是按框架进行的,我们没有衡量时间一致性。 适配器是决定性的,因此它不会增加自己的相框变异;闪烁器将来自每个相框独立地取样图像主干. 在初步运行中,我们把适配器放入一个视频传播解码器前,其条件与Control-DINO(Dominici等,2026年)一样。 虽然有些场景内容随时间而变化, 这些业务不属于评价范围。

blocks.en: Fine detail is bounded by the decoder. Small objects such as pedestrians lose their shape, and burned-in overlay text is not preserved. Part of this is our decoder’s, since a decoder built for these features reconstructs better (Appendix C.1 ), and the rest may come from the features.
blocks.zh: 精细以解码器为界. 行人等小型物体会失去外形,被烧毁的上覆文字没有保存. 这其中一部分是我们的解码器,因为为这些特征所建造的解码器重建得更好(Appendix C.1),其余可能来自这些特征.

blocks.en: The training data has to be varied. The adapter learns the residue from unpaired frames through the discriminators alone. When one side is small or narrow, a few dozen frames or a single scene, the discriminators can be matched by changing content instead of appearance, and the adapter then replaces scenes; we have seen this on a small out-of-domain set.
blocks.zh: 培训数据必须多种多样。 适配器单独通过歧视者从未放过的框架中学习出残留. 当一面是小或窄,有几十个相框或一出相片时,歧义者可以通过改变内容而不是外观来相配,适配者再取而代之;我们已经在一个小的域外相片上看到了这一点.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Unpaired translators carry the source domain through when their generator can still see it. We showed that a frozen DINO feature map holds the domain as a small residue, 13 to 14 % of the feature norm, and that an adapter moves it there while the identical adapter collapses on a VAE latent. A 2.9 M-parameter RFA in front of a decoder trained once is ahead of CycleGAN-Turbo on fog and on night KID and level with it on snow, rain and haze. It leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on sim-to-real and needs under a fifth of CycleGAN-Turbo’s per-condition training time. Decoders that never saw the adapter render its output. The cost is scene structure: the lossiness that removes the weather also moves objects, and both structure distance and a fixed detector measure it. The next step is to keep structure while the residue moves, through structure-consistency constraints or decoders that reconstruct more of the scene.
blocks.zh: 未发音的翻译员在他们的生成器仍能看见时,会携带源域通过. 我们显示,一个被冻结的DINO特征图将域作为一个小的残余物,占特征规范的13%至14%,一个适配器将它移动到那里,而同一个适配器则在VAE潜伏上崩溃. 曾经训练过的一个解码器前的2.9 M-参数RFA在雾上和夜间KID上领先CycleGAN-Turbo并用它在雪上,雨上和雾上平分. 它引导REGEN和HyPER-GAN在CycleGAN-Turbo每期培训时间的五分之一下实现实际和需求。 从未见过适配器输出的解码器. 成本是场景结构:去除天气的失落也使物体移动,结构距离和一个固定的探测器都会测量. 下一步是在残余物移动时保持结构,通过结构相容性约束或可重建更多场景的解码器.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All experiments use publicly released datasets under their own licences: ACDC and BDD100K driving footage, PreSIL (GTA V renders), Mapillary Vistas, and river-monitoring camera frames published by the USGS, in the selection released by Henein et al. (2026) . The driving datasets are used as their authors released them, with the anonymisation of faces and licence plates that they applied. We add no personal data and train no model that identifies people. The method renders images from semantic features, and, like every image-translation method, could in principle be misused to alter footage. The outputs studied here are weather changes and sim-to-real renders on public research data, and the paper reports the fidelity cost of the method as a first-class result. No human subjects were involved.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都根据自己的许可证使用公开发布的数据集:ACDC和BDD100K驱动镜头,PreSIL (GTA V makes),Mapillery Vistas,以及USGS发布的由Henein等人(2026年)发布的选择中河监测相机帧. 驾驶数据集是用在他们的作者释放他们时使用的,它们应用了面相和牌照的匿名. 我们不增加个人数据,也不培训识别人的模型。 该方法从语义特征来制作图像,而且与每一种图像翻译方法一样,原则上可以被滥用来改变镜头. 这里研究的产出是天气变化和从公共研究数据看成是实际的,论文将这种方法的忠诚成本作为头等结果。 没有涉及人类主体。

blocks.en: A.1 Discriminators, loss weights and configuration

blocks.en:
The vision-aided discriminator reads its frozen DINOv2 backbone at three depths

blocks.en: Architecture. The PatchGAN is the standard 70 × 70 70\times 70 design: four 4 × 4 4\times 4 convolutions with 64, 128, 256 and 512 channels at strides 2, 2, 2 and 1, instance normalisation with affine parameters after all but the first, LeakyReLU with slope 0.2, and a final 4 × 4 4\times 4 convolution to one logit per patch. It reads the rendered image at its full 1024 px, is trained with the least-squares GAN loss against a pool of the last 50 renders, and receives the R 1 R_{1} penalty on real images. The vision-aided discriminator is DINOv2-B with registers, frozen, fed the render at 224 px, tapped at blocks 3 and 6 (patch maps) and at the last block ([CLS]). The trained head is the multi-level head of Kumari et al. (2022) , a spectrally normalised 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution to 256 channels, LeakyReLU, blur pooling and a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to one logit on each patch map, and a linear 768 → \to 256 → \to 1 head on the [CLS] token, trained with their multi-level sigmoid loss. The PatchGAN earns its place under feature conditioning only: without it, colour drift under DINO conditioning roughly triples and structure degrades, while under latent conditioning, which carries colour itself, removing it costs nothing and structure improves.

blocks.en: ACDC ( Sakaridis et al., 2021 ) supplies fog, snow and rain (400 adverse and 900 clear frames per condition, with a seasonally offset clear correspondence). ACDC night is not used, because its shift is a lighting change and not an additive veil over the scene, and the night condition comes from BDD100K instead (1 664 day and 3 174 night training frames, 50 held-out frames per side, unpaired). Dehazing uses river-monitoring camera frames from the USGS Hydrologic Imagery Visualization and Information System, in the selection released by Henein et al. (2026) (88 unique hazy frames against 6 355 haze-free, unpaired, after removing the 37 hazy rows their listing duplicates). The haze baseline is its released dehazing checkpoint, a CycleGAN-Turbo finetuned on HIVIS, run with the authors’ released inference settings (no resize, hazy-to-clear direction, prompt “a clean image”). Its output reproduces the published example frame pixel for pixel (MAE 0.018, correlation 1.000), and on their full-frame protocol it reaches FID 155.2 against the published 153.3. BDD100K supplies night → \rightarrow day, and PreSIL (46 431 training and 4 644 validation frames at 1920 × \times 1080) and Mapillary Vistas supply the sim-to-real pair. The sim-to-real baselines are scored on the same 100 centre crops; HyPER-GAN’s own path squashes frames to 544 × \times 960, and both baselines pass a pixel-level self-test against their released outputs. CycleGAN and CUT run the CUT repository’s default 200 plus 200 epochs on ACDC; haze and night keep that run’s 360 000 iterations, which is 136 and 114 epochs on their larger training sides, and CycleGAN-Turbo runs its documented 25 000 steps.

blocks.en: Two numbers make the title’s claim literal (Table 7 ). The residue as defined in Section 3 is 13 to 14 % of the feature norm in every condition, with a per-frame spread of one to five points, and the same adapter fed a clear frame moves it by 3 to 6 %, close to the identity where there is nothing to remove. For scale, any other photograph sits about a full norm away in the same space, whatever its weather: the real clear photograph of the same place shot in another season at 106 to 118 %, an unrelated frame of the same weather at 101 to 121 %, an unrelated clear frame at 121 to 124 %, each an order of magnitude beyond the adapter’s move. That distance is a scene difference, not a weather difference, and the residue is the part the adapter rewrites within it. The measure depends on the feature space’s scale: the DINOv3-S configuration’s adapters on the DINOv3-S map at 1024 px (384 channels) move it by 7.2, 5.4, 5.4, 5.9 and 9.3 % on fog, snow, rain, haze and night, where the distance between two frames of the same weather is 0.46 to 0.61 instead of 1.01 to 1.21, so relative to that distance the residue is 11 to 14 % on DINOv2-B/reg and 10 to 16 % on DINOv3-S.

blocks.en: The lossiness above is measured through our decoder, and RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and VFM-VAE ( Bi et al., 2026 ) reconstruct well from frozen self-supervised features once the decoder is designed for it. Two measurements locate it. On the same held-out frames and the same DINOv2 map, RAE’s decoder reconstructs about 2 dB better than our ControlNet and reproduces sign text and window detail ours does not (Table 9 ), so that part of the loss is the decoder’s. A linear map from the features to the backbone’s own DC-AE latent explains only a third of that latent’s variance, while our ControlNet reconstructs better than that linear map, so the rest is not a merge problem but a property of what the features carry. Reconstruction MAE understates it, since it is dominated by large smooth regions while the failures are in high-frequency content, and no conditioning-side change we tried recovers it. This is the ceiling stated in Section 8 . A better decoder moves that ceiling: RAE decodes the same adapted map without retraining (Section 6.5 ) and reconstructs it 2 dB better, and an adapter trained through the almost lossless 23-layer RAEv2 decoder keeps far more structure at a distribution cost (Appendix D.4 ).
blocks.zh: 上面的失落度是通过我们的解码器来测量的,而RAE(郑等,2026年)和VFM-VAE(Bi等,2026年)在解码器被设计出来后,从被冻结的自监督的地物中重建得很好. 两个测量定位它。 RAE的解码器比我们的ControlNet更好地重建了大约2分贝, 从特性到骨干本身的DC-AE潜伏的线性映射只能解释这种潜伏相差的三分之一,而我们的ControlNet重建的比线性映射要好,所以其他的不是合并问题,而是特征所携带的东西的属性. 重建MAE低估了它,因为它以大平滑区域为主,而故障则以高频含量为主,而且我们没有试图恢复它。 这是第8节规定的上限。 一个更好的解码器移动了天花板:RAE在不进行再培训的情况下解码出相同的被调整的地图(第6.5节),并更好地重建了2 dB,通过几乎无损的23层RAEv2解码器训练出的一个适配器以分配成本保持了远为多的结构(附录D.4.).

blocks.en: A second bound, from the other end of the pipeline. Measuring patch Fréchet distance between sim and real, the gap shrinks by more than an order of magnitude after the trained ControlNet’s projection into its low-dimensional control space, so the projection is far more domain-invariant than the features feeding it. An adapter trained with a feature-space discriminator alone, no decoder in the loop, moves the feature statistics a good way toward the real domain (Fréchet distance to the real features from 4.8 to about 3.1, content cosine 0.95) or never leaves the identity, and in the first case its renders through the frozen ControlNet change little beyond road tone and material, the failure Section 4.1 states. This bounds how much visible change a feature-space adapter can produce for a given decoder, and it is why the adapter’s wins in Table 2 are distributional and not dramatic.
blocks.zh: 从输油管的另一端装入了第二束 测量Sim和Real之间的补丁Fréchet相距,在经过训练的控制网投射到其低维控制空间后,差距缩小了超过一个数量级,因此投射的域-不变量远大于提供给它的特性. 一个仅受地物空间歧视者训练的适配器在环路中没有解码器,将地物统计向真实域(Fréchet与真实域相距从4.8到约3.1,内容余弦0.95)移动得非常好,或者从未离开身份,在第一种情况下,通过被冻结的控制网,其成份变化几乎超出路基和材料,失败的第4.1节指出. 这限定了特性-空间适配器能够为给定解码器产生多少可见的变化,这也是适配器在表2中胜出的原因,是分布性的而不是戏剧性的.

blocks.en: Cosmos-Transfer 2.5 is the released 2 B model with no training on our data, run per frame in the image-to-image mode its documentation describes, with CycleGAN-Turbo’s target prompt on ACDC, a river-camera prompt on HIVIS and the day prompt on BDD100K. Driven by a blur map of the foggy frame it returns the foggy frame, no better than doing nothing on KID, because the blur map carries the fog. Driven by an edge map it produces a clean, sunlit street on the input’s edges and invents everything the edges do not fix, facades and sky included, at the worst MAE in the table. Snow and rain repeat this: the blur map hands the snow banks and the wet road back almost unchanged, and the edge map returns a sunlit street with the weather gone and the kerbs and facades redrawn. On HIVIS haze, where the input has almost no edges to give, the edge map returns a sunny river bank with the prompt’s monitoring camera painted into the foreground, at the worst KID in the table. Pixel control that keeps appearance keeps the weather, pixel control that drops appearance drops the scene with it, since a geometric signal captures only a narrow aspect of the scene ( Dominici et al., 2026 ) , and a DINO feature map sits between the two, which is what the RFA row shows.

blocks.en: CycleGAN-Turbo’s generator reads a near-invertible latent of the input, so pixel-level weather rides through it into the output: in Figure 2 the restored rain frame keeps the wet-road sheen and its reflections and the restored snow frame keeps the banks along the kerb. The adapter’s only input is the DINO feature map, which does not encode that residue, so the frozen decoder renders dry asphalt and bare kerbs from the same frames, and the structure it loses (structure distance, Table 2 ) is the price of the same lossiness. This is a trade-off, not a verdict, and Driving with DINO and HyPER-GAN’s comparison with REGEN report the same one, distribution against structure. It appears to be a property of the problem, not of any one architecture.

blocks.en: Figure 4 uses PiD’s own encoding for every input, PiD at four sampling steps, and RAE in one pass. What differs between the two decoders is what they do where the features are silent: PiD samples what it cannot read and changes the car’s colour and body, RAE does not sample and keeps the car yellow while shifting lighting and palette, so the colour change of Section 6.2 is the decoder’s, not the adapter’s. Neither decoder was trained on our domain as far as their papers state, so each carries a prior toward its own training distribution, and the raw column is the control: from the raw features both render the game frame back, so whatever separates the two columns of one decoder is the adapter’s doing and not the decoder’s prior.

blocks.en: C.7 Beyond driving: horse to zebra
blocks.zh: 第7条 驾驶之外:马到斑马

blocks.en: The paper’s benchmarks are driving footage, the domain the decoder was trained on. As a check that the recipe is not tied to that domain, the RFA was run on the CycleGAN horse-to-zebra set ( Zhu et al., 2017 ) and scored with CycleGAN-Turbo’s protocol for it ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) (Table 8 ). This is a demonstration on a consumer GPU with the DINOv3-S configuration (0.6 B ControlNet, batch 1 with four-step gradient accumulation), and it departs from the driving setting in three ways: the 256 px images are upscaled to 1024 px for the encoder and the decoder and the renders downscaled to 256 px for scoring; the augmentation is CycleGAN’s, horizontal flip and a mild random crop, instead of the weather recipe’s vertical flip and rotation; and the decoder was fine-tuned on the horse-to-zebra training images. Everything else is the weather recipe, run for 9 000 steps in the horse → \to zebra direction, once as is and once without the patch discriminator, which isolates that discriminator’s contribution. CycleGAN-Turbo has no released horse-to-zebra model, so it was trained on the same consumer GPU with the authors’ recipe (SD-Turbo, 25 000 steps, batch 1). That run ends at 49.0 FID and does not reach the paper’s 41.0. Both RFA runs beat CycleGAN on FID with CycleGAN-level structure and sit level with the CycleGAN-Turbo trained here. The two are within noise of each other on both scores, but the difference is visible in Figure 8 .

blocks.en: D.1 CycleGAN-Turbo’s claim, and its own evidence
blocks.zh: D.1 CycleGAN-Turbo的索赔及其本身的证据

blocks.en: CycleGAN-Turbo ( Parmar et al., 2024 ) reports that “directly applying standard diffusion adapters like ControlNet to the one-step setting proved less effective in our experiments” . Two pieces of evidence carry the claim. Its ablation Config B, a ControlNet encoder on the one-step model, matches the FID of the released design but has “a significantly higher DINO-Structure distance” , which the paper attributes to a conflict between the noise map and the conditioning inside a one-step network, and the adapter branch is dropped. And its Figure 8 places a one-step ControlNet next to the 100-step ControlNet: the 100-step one is competitive with their method, the one-step one is visibly degraded. Read together, the two say that a one-step ControlNet as they trained it fails, and leave open whether a ControlNet can be trained for a distilled model at all. Their test judges generation, where an under-denoised sample passes as plausible, and cannot settle it. Reconstruction can: with the feature map of a held-out frame as the conditioning, the render sits next to its ground truth, and every failure is visible and measurable. That is how we built ours (Appendix D.2 ), and it answers the question the other way. A ControlNet on the one-step Sana-Sprint reconstructs held-out frames better than the model’s own 20-step teacher, once two things in the training recipe are right: it is trained against the teacher and it is run with the student’s time convention. Its Config B, as far as the paper describes it, had neither. On SD-Turbo, whose teacher is not published, our own ControlNet recipes improved on their reported failure but did not remove it, which is why the port of Section 7 runs in the other direction.
blocks.zh: CycleGAN-Turbo(Parmar等人,2024年)报告说,“将ControlNet等标准传播适配器直接用于单步设置证明在我们的实验中不太有效”。 索赔有两件证据。 它的ablation Config B,是一阶模型上的一个ControlNet编码器,与所放设计的FID相匹配,但具有"显著更高的DINO-Structure相距",纸张将它归结为噪音图与一阶网络内部的调节相冲突,适配器分支被放弃. 它的图8将一个一步控制网放在了100步控制网旁边:100步控制网与其方法竞争,一步控制网明显退化. 两人一起阅读,表示他们训练的一步控制网失败,并留有是否可以训练一个控制网进行蒸馏模型. 他们的测试评断了一代人, 在那里一个被忽略的样本 通过是可信的, 并且不能解决它。 重建可以:以被搁置框架的特征图为条件,渲染物坐落在其地上真实相旁,每一次失败都是可见和可测量的. 这就是我们如何建造我们的(附录D.2),它以相反的方式回答了问题. 一旦培训食谱中的两件事是正确的, 由老师负责训练, 它的配置B, 就报纸描述的而言,都没有。 SD-Turbo的老师没有出版, 我们自己的ControlNet食谱改进了他们的失败报告,

blocks.en: D.2 Our one-step ControlNet, built as a reconstruction task
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 我们的一站式控制网是重建任务

blocks.en: The decoder is a ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) on Sana-Sprint, written for Sana’s transformer. Conditioning adapter. The frozen encoder’s feature map ( 384 × 64 × 64 384\times 64\times 64 for DINOv3-S at a 1024-px input, 768 × 32 × 32 768\times 32\times 32 for DINOv2-B/reg at 448 px in PiD’s normalisation) is brought to the 32 × 32 32\times 32 control map by a parameter-free 2 × 2 2\times 2 space-to-depth merge where the map is larger, followed by a small convolutional refinement whose last layer is zero-initialised, and projected to the 32 channels of the DC-AE latent, so that the control enters the ControlNet exactly as a latent would. ControlNet. Seven transformer blocks of the backbone’s width read the patchified control together with the noisy latent, the text tokens and the timestep. A zero-initialised linear layer injects the control into the first block and one per block adds that block’s output to the corresponding frozen block, so at initialisation the ControlNet leaves the backbone untouched. Training. The ControlNet is trained against the teacher , the published multi-step model Sana-Sprint was distilled from, with the teacher’s flow-matching objective (target noise − - x, time t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] t\in[0,1] drawn logit-normal), on Mapillary at 1024 px with a fixed caption and no conditioning dropout; batch 16, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} constant after 500 warmup steps, 8-bit Adam, bf16, gradient clipping at 0.3, 15 000 steps. Nothing in the backbone is trained. Inference. The trained ControlNet is plugged unchanged into the distilled student and run with the student’s sampler at its shipped two steps ( t = π / 2 t=\pi/2 , then 1.3, guidance 4.5, the student’s own guidance embedding). The teacher, when rendered for comparison, runs its default sampler unguided, since text guidance costs a ControlNet trained without conditioning dropout 5 to 6.5 dB on every teacher we tried (18.41 dB unguided against 13.64 at guidance 4.5). The one detail that matters: the student’s sampler works in TrigFlow time t ∈ [ 0 , π / 2 ] t\in[0,\pi/2] and the ControlNet was trained in flow-matching time, so the pipeline converts the sampler’s time as sin ⁡ t / ( cos ⁡ t + sin ⁡ t ) \sin t/(\cos t+\sin t) , rescales the latents accordingly and converts the prediction back at every evaluation.

blocks.en: With the sampler’s raw TrigFlow time fed to the ControlNet, every render came out under-denoised and drifting to saturated colour, because the ControlNet was evaluated at times up to 1.57 on unscaled latents, outside anything it had seen. On the paper’s decoder the raw-time render at the shipped two steps scores 9.0 dB and gradNCC 0.18 against 20.5 dB and 0.51 with the conversion (four frames), and its chroma error grows with the number of out-of-range evaluations while the converted path holds. Two things follow. First, the failure is invisible in the setting CycleGAN-Turbo reports it in, generation , where an under-denoised, oversaturated image is a plausible sample, and obvious in reconstruction , where the same image sits next to its ground truth. Their one-step ControlNet losing to the 100-step one in their Figure 8 is the symptom we saw, and we read it as the same mismatch between a distilled sampler and a ControlNet trained under another convention, which we cannot check because the ablation configuration is not released. Second, once the convention is right the student is not the weaker decoder: trained against the teacher and run on the student, the ControlNet reconstructs held-out frames better with two student steps than the teacher does with twenty (on the 50 frames of Table 9 , scored at the 1024-px output: 17.8 against 17.0 dB for the 1.6 B pair and 19.5 against 18.0 dB for the 0.6 B pair, the same ordering for every conditioning we trained), so the distilled model is the right place to run it (Figure 9 ). The two inference steps are the shipped default, not a tuned choice: rendering the same weather adapters at one step instead of two moves KID within re-scoring noise (fog 0.028 against 0.026, snow 0.019 against 0.021, rain 0.016 against 0.016, haze 0.040 against 0.038), FID by one to three points in the one-step direction, and structure distance by 0.001 to 0.006 in the two-step direction.
blocks.zh: 随着采样者原始的TrigFlow时间被输入到控制网,每个渲染物都呈现出被忽略并漂移到饱和的颜色上,因为控制网被评估时有时高达1.57分的未分级潜入物,而不在它所看到的一切之外。 在纸张的解码器上,运出的两个步骤的原始时间渲染分数为9.0分贝和GradNCC 0.18分,而转换为20.5分贝和0.51分贝(4个帧),其染色体误差随着外程评价数的增加而增加,而转换的路径则保持不变。 二事随顺. 首先,在设定 CycleGAN-Turbo 中, 失败是隐形的, 在一代人中, 一个被忽略的,过度饱和的图像是一个可信的样本, 在重建中很明显, 他们的"一步控制网"在图8中输给"一步"的"一步",就是我们看到的症状,我们读到的是,一个蒸馏取样器和另一个常规下训练的"一步控制网"(ControlNet)之间的同样不匹配,我们无法检查,因为阴极配置没有被放出. 第二,一旦会议正确,学生就不是较弱的解码器:对老师进行培训并运行在学生身上,ControlNet用两个学生台阶重建了更好的被扣出架子,比老师用二十个台阶(在表9的50个台框上,在1024-px输出时得分:对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一,对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一的一对一对一),因此,ControlNet用两个学生台一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对一对 两个推论步骤是被运出默认,而不是调取的选择:使同一种天气适配器在一个步骤上,而不是两个在再评分噪声内移动的KID(雾0.028对0.026,雪0.019对0.021,雨0.016对0.016,雾0.040对0.038),FID在一步方向上1到3分,结构距离在二步方向上为0.001到0.006.

blocks.en: D.3 The same-backbone comparison, and what the port required
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 同一背骨的比较, 以及港口需要什么

blocks.en: Our decoder recipe needs the backbone’s multi-step teacher (Appendix D.2 ), which Sana-Sprint publishes and SD-Turbo does not (SD-2 base is a surrogate), so the comparison that holds the backbone fixed ports their method to ours (Section 7 ) as a best-effort rebuild that keeps every choice their paper or code fixes and states every choice the backbone forces. What the port does not control is the difference in what is trainable, a generator per domain pair against one shared decoder and an adapter per pair, so Table 2 stays a task-level comparison with the backbone held fixed for the CycleGAN-Sprint rows.
blocks.zh: 我们的解码器配方需要骨干多步骤的老师(Appendix D.2 ) , Sana-Sprint出版,SD-Turbo不出版(SD-2基础是代词),因此,将骨干固定端口的方法与我们的(第7节)作比较,作为最佳的重建方法,保持每个选择的纸张或代码固定,并声明每个选择的骨干力量。 端口不控制的是可训练内容的差异,每个域对一对共享解码器的生成器和每对适配器,因此表2保留了与CycleGAN-Sprint行所固定所持有的主干线的任务级比较.

blocks.en: What the port required. Their recipe rests on a premise the paper does not state: fed the encoded input in place of the noise map at the last timestep, the frozen one-step model already returns approximately that image, so the LoRA only has to learn the translation. On SD-Turbo this holds. On Sana-Sprint it does not: the DC-AE round trip is 0.028 L1 from the input, but the frozen model’s one-step prediction from the encoded latent is 0.472 L1 away. The verbatim rebuild spent its LoRA on reconstruction and then collapsed to the identity, with the cycle and identity terms holding it there. Making the LoRA a residual on the frozen prediction, x 0 = z − ( v LoRA − v frozen ) x_{0}=z-(v_{\text{LoRA}}-v_{\text{frozen}}) , restores the premise: the generator is exactly the identity at initialisation, as their recipe presumes. With the premise restored, their adversarial weight of 0.5 still held the generator at the input (fog KID 0.071 against 0.105 for doing nothing, structure distance 0.007): a per-term gradient probe on the LoRA gave the adversarial term one fiftieth of the cycle term’s gradient norm, so it is swamped on this backbone. Raising it to 2.0 or 4.0 produces a translator; the two are within noise of each other on KID (0.037 and 0.034) and 2.0 keeps measurably more structure (structure distance 0.016 against 0.019); the paper reports 4.0, the lower KID. The residual form and the adversarial weight are the whole of the departure from their recipe, and each is what made the method train on this backbone at all.
blocks.zh: 港口需要什么? 他们的食谱基于论文没有说明的前提:在最后一个时间步输入了被编码的输入来代替噪音图,被冻结的一步模型已经返回了大约该图像,所以LORA只需要学习翻译. 在SD -Turbo这里 在Sana-Sprint上,它不会:DC-AE的回程从输入中算出0.028 L1,但被冻结的模型从编码后潜入的一步预测是0.472 L1 离开. 逐字记录重建将其LORA花在了重建上,然后倒向了身份,其循环和身份术语支撑着它. 让LORA在被冻结的预测上留有后遗症,x 0=z-(v LORA-v被冻结)x_{0}=z-(v_{\text{LORA}}-v_{\text{被冻结),恢复了前提:生成者在初始化时正是身份,正如他们的配方所假设的那样. 随着前提的恢复,他们的0.5的对抗性重量仍然控制着输入时的发电机(fog KID 0.071对0.105,因为无所事事,结构距离0.007): LORA上每期的梯度探测器给出了周期术语梯度规范的一分之一的对抗性术语,因此它被淹没在这个主干上. 将其提升为2.0或4.0生成一个翻译器;两者在KID(0.037和0.034)上相互间存在噪声;而2.0保持了可估量的更强的结构(结构相距0.016相比0.019相比);纸上报出4.0相比更低的KID. 剩余形式和对抗力的重量是离开其食谱的全部,每一个都是使方法列车在这个主干上完全产生.

blocks.en: Backbone: Sana-Sprint 1.6 B frozen, LoRA of rank 128 on the transformer and a LoRA of rank 4 plus skip connections on the DC-AE autoencoder, the ranks and skips of their training code. Generator: the encoded input replaces the noise map at Sana-Sprint’s last timestep ( t = 1, the analogue of their t = 999), no added noise, one transformer evaluation, guidance 4.5, LoRA as a residual on the frozen prediction. Losses, as in their code: two vision-aided CLIP discriminators ( Kumari et al., 2022 ) with multi-level convolutional heads, one per domain, adversarial weight 4.0 (their 0.5); cycle L1 weight 1.0 with LPIPS weight 2.0 (their 10.0); identity L1 1.0 with LPIPS 1.0. Data and schedule: 512 px with their preprocessing (resize, then random crop), batch 1, learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} for generator and discriminators with 500 warmup steps, gradient clipping at 10, 25 000 steps, reported at the end of the recipe like the released model, and one-sentence prompts per domain (“a photo of a driving scene in clear weather”, “…in dense fog”). Trainable weights and cost are in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 后骨:Sana-Sprint 1.6 B被冻结,变压器上为128等的LORA,外加4等的LORA并跳过DC-AE自动编码器上的连接,分级和跳过他们的训练代码. 生成器:编码输入取代了Sana-Sprint最后一站的噪音图(t = 1,其t = 999相仿),没有增加噪音,一个变压器评价,指向4.5,LORA作为冷冻预测的剩余. 损失,如其代码:两个视觉辅助的CLIP歧视者(Kumari等,2022年),多层次的分级头,每个领域一个,对抗重量4.0(他们的0.5);周期L1重量1.0与LPIPS重量2.0(他们的10.0);身份L11.0与LPIPS 1.0. 数据和时间表:512个px及其预处理(大小,再作随机收成),第1批,用于500个取暖步骤的发电机和歧视器的学习速率10 - 5 10 - 5 5 ;梯度剪接到10 25,000个步骤,在食谱结尾处报告,如释放的模型,每个域的一分刑提示(“在晴朗的天气中,一个驾驶场的照片”,“......在浓雾中”)。 可训练重量和费用见表6。

blocks.en: A convergence. Their Config B matches FID while losing DINO-Structure, the pattern of Table 2 , where the RFA matches or wins KID and loses structure distance. Two measurements on different backbones with different objectives show the same trade, which points at the conditioning path and not at any one implementation.
blocks.zh: 一个趋同。 他们的配置B在失去DINO-Structure的同时匹配了FID,这是表2的图案,其中RFA匹配或赢得了KID并失去了结构距离. 对目标不同的不同骨干进行的两项测量显示相同的贸易,这种贸易指向条件路径,而不是任何一项执行。

blocks.en: D.4 Is the diffusion decoder needed?
blocks.zh: D.4 联合国 是否需要扩散解码器?

blocks.en: No. The pipeline needs one differentiable pass from a DINO feature map to pixels (Section 4.1 ). The one-step diffusion ControlNet is the pass this work inherits from the Control-DINO lineage, kept because it is fast, cheap to train and renders at 1024 px. It is not the best decoder available, and it is interchangeable: RAE decodes the same adapted map without retraining (Section 6.5 ), the reconstruction test below locates the detail our ControlNet loses, and the same adapter recipe trains through three other frozen decoders (Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 没有 管道需要从DINO特征图到像素的可分异的通道(第4.1节)。 单步扩散控制网是本作继承自Control-DINO分行的传入,保存是因为它速度快,训练费用低廉,制作速度为1024px. 它不是最好的解码器,而且可以互换: RAE在不进行再培训的情况下解码相同的被修改的地图(第6.5节),下面的重建测试定位了我们ControlNet丢失的细节,同样的适配器食谱列车通过其他三个被冻结的解码器(表10).

blocks.en: Reconstruction. On 50 held-out Mapillary frames, RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) reconstructs the same DINOv2-B/reg map our DINOv2 ControlNet consumes about 2 dB better (20.14 against 18.21) and keeps sign text and window detail ours loses. The DINOv3-S configuration’s ControlNet at 1024 px matches RAE on PSNR (20.10) with better edges (gradNCC 0.650 against 0.557; Table 9 , Figure 11 ). RAEv2’s released decoders ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , scored at their native 256 px on the same frames, add one point: a single-layer decoder on the last DINOv3-S layer reaches 19.5 dB, and the same ViT-XL decoder fed the sum of all 23 DINOv3-L layers reaches 26.8 dB trained on ImageNet and 29.1 dB trained on general data, close to the autoencoder ceiling, a representation the RFA does not use.
blocks.zh: 重建事业. 在50个被搁置的Mapillery帧上,RAE(郑等,2026年)重建了相同的DINov2-B/reg地图,我们的DINov2 ControlNet消耗了约2分贝(20.14比18.21),并保留了签名文本和窗口细节我们的损失. DINOv3-S配置的ControlNet 1024 px在PSNR(20.10)上与RAE匹配,边缘较好(gradNCC 0.650对0.557;表9,图11). RAEv2的放出解码器(Singh等,2026)在同一帧上以256 px的原发分数得分,增加了一分:DNOv3-S层的单层解码器达到19.5 dB,而同一Vit-XL解码器在ImageNet上装入了全部23个DINOv3-L层的总和达到26.8 dB,在一般数据上装入了29.1 dB,接近自编码器上限,RFA没有使用这一代表.

blocks.en: Translation. The adapter recipe also trains through RAE’s decoder and through RAEv2’s single-layer DINOv3-S and 23-layer DINOv3-L decoders in place of our ControlNet, with encoder and decoder frozen exactly as the ControlNet is and every loss weight, the batch and the step count of Table 5 unchanged (Table 10 ). Two settings follow the decoder: the resolution, 512 px for RAE and 256 px for RAEv2, to which the real and sim crops are downsampled for the discriminators while the features are computed as before, and an added RGB identity term, because a deterministic decoder gives the adapter more leverage over global tone than the diffusion prior does and the discriminators otherwise chase a tone shift as the cheapest direction. At a common 512 px our ControlNet has the best distribution scores (KID 0.012 against 0.020 through RAE and 0.028 through the 23-layer RAEv2 decoder). The 23-layer decoder, which reconstructs almost losslessly (Table 9 ), keeps far more structure (structure distance 0.019 against our 0.032) and reaches KID 0.020 at its own 256 px, against our 0.012. RAE sits between on both, and the single-layer RAEv2 decoder is last on KID and FID and level with ours on structure (0.031 against 0.032). The diffusion decoder is not needed, and the trade of Section 6.3 follows the decoder: the more it can reconstruct, the more of the scene the adapted frame keeps.
blocks.zh: 翻译. 适配器配方也通过RAE的编解码器和RAEv2的单层DINov3-S和23层DINov3-L编解码器来进行列车,其编解码器与ControlNet完全一样被冻结,每减重,批量和表5的分数不变(表10). 解码器后面有两个设置:分辨率为512 px for RAE和256 px for RAEv2, 真实和 sim 的收成在像以前一样计算特征时被降低给歧视者采样,另外还有一个添加的RGB身份名词,因为一个决定性的解码器使适配器比之前的传播更有全球语气的杠杆,而歧视者则以最便宜的方向追求调子的转变. 在常见的 512 px 中, 我们的 ControlNet 拥有最好的分布分数( KID 0.012 和 0.020 通过 RAE 和 0.028 通过 23 级 RAEv2 解码器) 。 23层的解码器几乎毫无损失地重建(表9),保持了更大的结构(结构距离0.019与我们的0.032相对),并在自己的256px上达到KID 0.020,与我们的0.012相对. RAE位于两者之间,单层的RAEv2解码器最后位于KID和FID上,与我们的平面在结构上(0.031对0.032). 扩散解码器不需要,而第6.3节的交易遵循了解码器:它越能重建,改编后的框架所保存的场景就越多.

The DC-AE row is the autoencoder round trip of the ground truth, the ceiling for any render through it. Bold best of the three decoders.

KID and FID at a common 512 px against the 2 000 Mapillary crops at that size, then at each decoder’s native output size against references at that size (comparable only within a row’s size), and structure distance to the source crop.

blocks.en: Appendix E Decoder bias: the frozen decoder on unadapted features
blocks.zh: 附录 E 解码器偏差:未调整特性上被冻结的解码器

blocks.en: The decoder was trained on Mapillary, a clear-weather daytime set, so how much of the weather removal is its own doing before any adapter is involved is a fair question, which the decoder-only rows of Table 2 answer: the unadapted feature map of each adverse test frame, rendered by the same frozen decoder at the same two steps and caption as the RFA rows. On fog the decoder alone changes almost nothing on KID (0.110 against 0.107 for doing nothing) while the RFA reaches 0.026. On snow and rain it removes a little (0.068 against 0.073, 0.032 against 0.042), a fraction of what the adapter removes, and on haze it makes the distribution worse (0.080 against 0.050), a decoder that has never seen river cameras rendering their features in its own style. Figure 12 shows the same frames as Figure 2 : the decoder-only row renders the weather back, fog, snow banks, wet road and haze included, and the change between it and the RFA row is the adapter’s. The bias is real but small, because these domains were hardly present in the decoder’s training data: the features of a foggy frame are close enough to a clear one’s for the decoder to render fog back, and what separates them is the residue the adapter moves. The same decoder-only test through RAE’s decoder, which never saw our adapter or our data, gives KID 0.105, 0.076, 0.044, 0.074 and 0.133 on fog, snow, rain, haze and night, within noise of doing nothing or above it in every condition, so neither decoder removes weather on its own and the removal in Table 2 is the adapter’s whichever decoder renders it.
blocks.zh: 解码器是在Mapillery上训练的,一个晴天的日出设定,所以在任何适配器参与之前,除去天气的多少是自己做的是一个公平的问题,表2的解码器只用一行回答:每个不利试验框的未适应特征图,由同被冷冻的解码器在与RFA行相同的两个步骤和标题下制取. 在雾中,解码器在KID上几乎没有任何变化(0.110与0.107因无所事事),而RFA则达到了0.026. 在雪地和雨地上,它去掉了一点(0.068对0.073,0.032对0.042),是适配器去掉的一小部分,在雾霾上,它使分布更加糟糕(0.080对0.050),这个解码器从未见过河相机用自己的风格来渲染其特征. 图12显示与图2相同的框架:只有解码器的一行使得天气恢复了,雾,雪库,湿道和雾霾也包括在内,它和RFA一行之间的变化是适配器的. 偏差是真实的,但很小,因为这些域在解码器的训练数据中几乎没有存在:雾框的特征足够接近清晰的一面来让解码器回放出雾来,它们分离的就是适配器所移动的残留物. 在雾、雪、雨、雾和夜间, 通过RAE的解码器进行同样的解码器唯一的测试, 它从未见过我们的适配器或数据,

blocks.en: Appendix F Is the weather gone?
blocks.zh: 附录F 天气没了?

blocks.en: KID and FID reward removal without separating it from over-removal and structure distance measures change, so none of the benchmark metrics says whether the weather itself is gone. A logistic classifier on pooled DINOv2-B/reg features, trained to tell adverse from clear frames on the ACDC training crops (400 per class, held-out accuracy 1.00 on all three conditions), gives per method the share of test outputs it calls clear (Table 11 ). As a control, the same classifier trained to split one class into two random halves reaches held-out accuracy 0.39 to 0.46 on the clear halves and 0.30 to 0.43 on the adverse halves, at or below chance (0.5), so the accuracy of 1.00 is not a fit to arbitrary structure in 800 crops. The decoder-only row stays near zero, so the classifier reads the adapter and not the decoder. The classifier reads the same DINOv2 features the adapter moves, so it is not independent of the adapter’s space; on rain the distribution metrics, which read Inception features, agree with it. On rain the RFA clears every frame where the pixel-fed baselines clear about half, and Cosmos-Transfer’s edge control also clears 96 %, by redrawing the scene (Appendix C.2 ). On snow every method but Cosmos blur clears every frame, so the condition does not discriminate. On fog the pixel-space GANs are called clear on every frame and the RFA on 68 %, with a confound the number cannot resolve: the clear training crops are summer frames, so the classifier may read foliage as much as fog, and CycleGAN and CUT grow leaves (Section 6.1 ). Haze and night have no training crop set and are not scored.
blocks.zh: KID和FID在不将其与过度去除和结构相距度量相分离的情况下给予奖励去除,因此没有一个基准度量标准表示天气本身是否已经消失. 集成的DINOv2-B/reg特性的后勤分类器,经过培训,能够从非洲抗旱委员会培训作物的清晰框架中辨别出不良之处(每班400个,在所有三个条件下保持1.00的准确度),使每个方法得到它所称的明确的试验产出份额(表11)。 作为一种控制,受过将一个类别分成两个随机分出部分的同一分类器在明确分出部分上达到0.39至0.46分,在不利分出部分上达到0.30至0.43分,在概率或低于概率(0.5分),因此1.00分出的精确度与800个作物的任意结构不相适应。 只有解码器的行会保持接近于零,所以分类器会读取适配器而不会读取解码器. 分级器读取了相同的 DINov2 特性适配器移动,因此它不独立于适配器的空间;在雨上读取受体特性的分布度量衡也同意. 在下雨时, RFA通过重新绘制场景(Appendix C.2 ), 清除了每个框架, 其中以像素为基准的基线清空了大约一半, Cosmos-Transfer的边缘控制也清空了96%. 在雪上每一种方法,但宇宙模糊了每个框架,因此条件没有差别. 在雾中,像素空间的GAN在每个帧上被叫作清晰,而RFA在68%上被叫作清晰,一个错位数字无法解析:清晰的训练作物是夏相框,因此分类器可以读取与雾一样多的叶子,CyleGAN和CUT会生长出叶子(第6.1节). 烟雾和夜间没有训练作物,也没有得分。

blocks.en: Table 11: Share of test outputs a classifier trained on the ACDC training crops calls clear, per method and condition, 50 frames each.
blocks.zh: 表11:接受过非加太作物培训培训的分类人员在测试产出中所占的份额,按方法和条件分别要求明确50个帧。

blocks.en: Appendix G Downstream detection
blocks.zh: 附录G 下游探测

blocks.en: Structure distance says how much a method changed; a detector says whether the objects are still there. A fixed torchvision Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50 FPN v2, COCO weights, never trained or tuned on our data) reads every method’s output at 512 px, with predictions restricted to the seven BDD100K classes COCO also has, and the score is COCO mAP at IoU 0.5 to 0.95, with mAP at 0.5 and 0.75 alongside (Table 12 ). Two protocols apply. On weather, the test frames are 300 real snowy and 300 real rainy BDD100K frames that carry official boxes, centre-cropped square with the boxes clipped, and the ACDC-trained snow and rain models of every method are applied to them unchanged, so the boxes are ground truth and doing nothing is the bar to clear. On sim-to-real, PreSIL carries no boxes we hold, so the same detector’s confident boxes on the untranslated render (score at least 0.5, 962 boxes on the 100 crops) stand in for ground truth, and doing nothing scores 1.0 by construction; the informative rows are the translators, and the number reads as the share of the source’s detectable objects that survive in place.
blocks.zh: 结构距离表示一种方法改变多少;一个探测器表示物体是否还在. 固定火炬视速快R-CNN(ResNet-50 FPN v2,COCO重量,从未受过训练或调用我们的数据)读取了每种方法的输出为512 px,预测仅限于7个BDD100K级COCO也有,分数是IoU0.5至0.95的COCO mAP,mAP为0.5和0.75并列(表12)。 适用两项协议。 在天气方面,测试框为300个正中下雪和300个正中降雨的BDD100K框架,这些框架搭载了官方的箱子,被剪接了的盒子被中取出正方形,并且对每种方法的ACDC所训练的雪和雨模型都不加改变地应用在它们身上,所以盒子是地上真实的,无所事事是清除的栏杆. 在现实中,PreSIL没有携带我们持有的盒子,因此同一探测器在未翻译的渲染物上的自信盒(在100个作物上至少得分为0.5,962个盒子)站立在地上,没有通过构造来做1.0的分数;信息行是翻译,数字读取的是源可探测物体中存活在原地的份额.

blocks.en: The result is against us on both protocols. On weather the RFA roughly halves mAP against the untouched frame while CycleGAN-Turbo and CycleGAN keep it, and Cosmos-Transfer’s blur control loses even more. On sim-to-real the RFA keeps a sixth of the objects where REGEN and HyPER-GAN keep two thirds to three quarters. The detector is already good on snow and rain, so the weather rows measure geometry retention against the original boxes, the structure-distance trade in pixels: objects that move or change shape lose their boxes. This is the cost stated in Section 6.3 and Section 8 , measured on a task.
blocks.zh: 在这两项议定书上,结果都不利于我们。 而Cosmos-Transfer的模糊控制则失去更多。 在正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正 探测器在雪地和雨地上已经很好,因此气象行对照原始的相框测量几何保留,像素的结构-距离交易:移动或改变形状的物体会丢失相框. 这是第6.3和8节所述费用,按一项任务计算。

blocks.en: Table 2 and Table 3 are point estimates on 50, 25 and 100 crops. Table 13 gives leave-one-out jackknife standard errors of KID and FID for the RFA and its main baseline per condition, and of their paired difference, where the same input crop is dropped from both methods, so the error of the difference is the one for the comparison. The features are the clean-fid Inception features of the same crops, scored in a separate pass from Table 2 , so the points differ from it by re-scoring noise (Section 5 ). Fog and sim-to-real are separated by two to five standard errors on KID and night by 1.6; snow, rain and haze are within one, which is the tie the text states. The FID differences on rain and haze are one to one and a half standard errors.
